```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
devtools::load_all()

library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)
```

# 0. Intro

```{r}
# Phyloseq objects :
#  - OTU table = taxa in rows (OTU), samples in columns (matrix of numbers => abundance data)
#  - sample table = samples in rows, description variables in columns from metadata (data frame object)
#  - taxonomy table = taxa in rows (OTU), taxonomic ranks in columns 
```

# 1. Import Data

```{r}
# Import 16S Abundance table
atc_16S <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "16S_TM123_abundance.tsv"), sep="\t",header=TRUE) 
dim(atc_16S) # 4615 720

# Delete Controls and Undetermined
atc_16S_nocontrol <- atc_16S %>% 
  dplyr::select(!(dplyr::contains("CT_") | 
                  dplyr::contains("NC_") |
                  dplyr::starts_with("Undetermined")))
dim(atc_16S_nocontrol) # 4615 336

# Deletion of 16S- prefixes in sample names
colnames(atc_16S_nocontrol) <- gsub("16S_", "", colnames(atc_16S_nocontrol))

# Import ITS Abundance table
atc_ITS <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "ITS_TM123_abundance.tsv"), sep="\t",header=TRUE)
dim(atc_ITS) # 1303 565

# Delete Controls and Undetermined
atc_ITS_nocontrol <- atc_ITS %>% 
  dplyr::select(!(dplyr::contains("CT_") | 
                  dplyr::contains("NC_") |
                  dplyr::starts_with("Undetermined")))
dim(atc_ITS_nocontrol) # 1303 312

# Deletion of ITS- prefixes in sample names
colnames(atc_ITS_nocontrol) <- gsub("ITS_", "", colnames(atc_ITS_nocontrol))


# Import 16S and ITS taxonomy tables
taxo_16S <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "16S_TM123_taxonomy.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)

taxo_ITS <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "ITS_TM123_taxonomy.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)


# Import Metadata table
metadata <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "TransMicro123_metadata.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)

samples_to_distinguish <- c("CT_INDEX_3_rn2", "MS_001_rn3", "MS_098_rn3", "MS_148_rn3", "MS_151_rn3", "MS_163_rn3", "MS_167_rn3", "MS_263_rn3")

metadata <- add_marker_to_id(metadata, samples_to_distinguish)

length(unique((metadata$ID_pool)[ metadata$Marker != "ITS"])) #nb of 16S samples = 464
length(unique((metadata$ID_pool)[ metadata$Marker != "16S"])) #nb of ITS samples = 374
```

# 2. Create a phyloseq object

```{r}
# Abundance tables
otu_16S <- atc_16S_nocontrol %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(seed_sequence = NULL)

otu_ITS <- atc_ITS_nocontrol %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(seed_sequence = NULL) 

# Taxonomy tables
tax_16S <- taxo_16S %>% 
  #dplyr::left_join(atc_16S_nocontrol %>% select(observation_name, seed_sequence) , by = "observation_name") %>%
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name")
tax_16S <- as.matrix(tax_16S)

tax_ITS <- taxo_ITS %>% 
  #dplyr::left_join(atc_ITS_nocontrol %>% select(observation_name, seed_sequence) , by = "observation_name") %>%
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name")
tax_ITS <- as.matrix(tax_ITS)

# Metadata
mtd <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ID_pool = sapply(ID_pool, Remove_last_two_chars_run)) %>% # Remove runs distinction (1, 2 or 3)
  dplyr::mutate(ID_pool_rowname = ID_pool) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ID_pool_rowname = ID_pool) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Marker, -Run) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(ID_pool) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across( .cols = everything(), .fns = ~ ifelse(length(unique(.x)) == 1, unique(.x), paste(unique(.x), collapse = ";")) ), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("ID_pool_rowname")
  

write.table(mtd, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "TM123_reduced_metadata.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

#Transform into phyloseq compatible objects
OTU_16S <- phyloseq::otu_table(otu_16S, taxa_are_rows = T)
TAX_16S <- phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax_16S))

OTU_ITS <- phyloseq::otu_table(otu_ITS, taxa_are_rows = T)
TAX_ITS <- phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax_ITS))

#MTD <- phyloseq::sample_data(as.data.frame(mtd))
# # Build a phyloseq objects
# ps_16S <- phyloseq::phyloseq(OTU_16S, TAX_16S, MTD)
# ps_ITS <- phyloseq::phyloseq(OTU_ITS, TAX_ITS, MTD)

ps_16S <- phyloseq(OTU_16S, TAX_16S, sample_data(mtd))
ps_ITS <- phyloseq(OTU_ITS, TAX_ITS, sample_data(mtd))

ps_16Sm <- merge_samples(ps_16S,group = "ID_pool",fun = sum)
ps_ITSm <- merge_samples(ps_ITS,group = "ID_pool",fun = sum)

sample_data(ps_16Sm) <- sample_data(ps_16S) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(ID_pool) %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    ~ ifelse(length(unique(.x)) == 1, unique(.x), NA)
  )) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ID_pool") %>%
  sample_data()

sample_data(ps_ITSm) <- sample_data(ps_ITS) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(ID_pool) %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    ~ ifelse(length(unique(.x)) == 1, unique(.x), NA)
  )) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ID_pool") %>%
  sample_data()



# Extract OTU abundance data from phyloseq objects
table_OTU_16S <- phyloseq::otu_table(ps_16Sm)
table_OTU_16S[rowSums(phyloseq::otu_table(ps_16Sm)) == 0, ] # OTUs with no counts in any 16S samples
names(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_16Sm)[ phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_16Sm) == 0]) #samples with no reads

table_OTU_ITS <- phyloseq::otu_table(ps_ITSm)
table_OTU_ITS[rowSums(phyloseq::otu_table(ps_ITSm)) == 0, ] # OTUs with no counts in any ITS samples
names(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_ITSm)[ phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_ITSm) == 0]) #samples with no reads
```

## Remove Wolbachia + conta
```{r}
# Remove Wolbachia
tax_ps <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_16Sm))

wolbachia_taxa <- rownames(tax_ps[!is.na(tax_ps$Genus) & tax_ps$Genus == "Wolbachia", ]) # List of Wolbachia clusters

otu_ps <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_16Sm))
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_16Sm)) otu_ps <- t(otu_ps)

sum(otu_ps[wolbachia_taxa, , drop = FALSE]) / sum(otu_ps) * 100 ## Relative abundance of Wolbachia = 16.76 %

ps_16Sm <- prune_taxa(!(taxa_names(ps_16Sm) %in% wolbachia_taxa), ps_16Sm) ## Remove


# Remove 16S conta
Genus_conta_16S <- c("Lentihominibacter", "Cutibacterium", "Corynebacterium")
Fam_conta_16S <- c("Anaerovoracaceae")

taxa_to_remove_16S <- TAX_16S_df %>%
  filter(Family %in% Fam_conta_16S | Genus %in% Genus_conta_16S) %>%
  rownames()
  
write.xlsx( TAX_16S_df[taxa_to_remove_16S, ], file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data",  "2_RarefyData","Conta_clusters_16S.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE) #export removed clusers

ps_16Sm <- prune_taxa(!(taxa_names(ps_16Sm) %in% taxa_to_remove_16S),ps_16Sm)


# Remove ITS conta
Fam_conta_ITS <- c("Malasseziaceae")
TAX_ITS_df <- as.data.frame(TAX_ITS)

taxa_to_remove_ITS <- TAX_ITS_df %>%
  filter(Family %in% Fam_conta_ITS) %>%
  rownames()
  
write.xlsx( TAX_ITS_df[taxa_to_remove_ITS, ], file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data",  "2_RarefyData","Conta_clusters_ITS.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE) #export removed clusers

ps_ITSm <- prune_taxa(!(taxa_names(ps_ITSm) %in% taxa_to_remove_ITS),ps_ITSm)
```


```{r}
# Distribution of the number of reads across samples
sample_sums(ps_16Sm) #for each sample
sum(sample_sums(ps_16Sm)) #total
min(sample_sums(ps_16Sm)) #min
max(sample_sums(ps_16Sm)) #max
mean(sample_sums(ps_16Sm)) # mean 11111.32

sample_sums(ps_ITSm) #for each sample
sum(sample_sums(ps_ITSm)) #total
min(sample_sums(ps_ITSm)) #min
max(sample_sums(ps_ITSm)) #max
mean(sample_sums(ps_ITSm)) # mean = 9913.682

# Identify samples with a sum of abundances equal to zero
zero_abundance_samples_16S <- names(sample_sums(ps_16Sm)[ sample_sums(ps_16Sm) == 0]) # 33 samples
zero_abundance_samples_ITS <- names(sample_sums(ps_ITSm)[ sample_sums(ps_ITSm) == 0]) # 7 samples

# Remove samples with a sum of abundances equal to zero from the phyloseq object
ps_16S_filtered <- subset_samples(ps_16Sm, !(sample_names(ps_16Sm) %in% zero_abundance_samples_16S))
ps_ITS_filtered <- subset_samples(ps_ITSm, !(sample_names(ps_ITSm) %in% zero_abundance_samples_ITS))
```

# 3. Rarefaction curve
## a. All samples
```{r}
Rarefactioncurve_16S <- phyloseq.extended::ggrare(ps_16S_filtered, step = 100, se = FALSE, color = "SampleType", label = "ID_pool") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3000, linetype = "dashed") +
  xlim(0, 10000) +  ylim(0, 150) +  theme_bw()

# Make_rarefaction_curve2(phylo_object = ps_16S_filtered, x_intersection_line = 3000, plot_variable = "SampleType", color_variable = "SampleType", maxdepth=10000, logy=TRUE) # curves plotted for seq depth up to 10.000 reads per sample (17 types of samples)

title_plot <- "16S_TM123_Rarefactioncurve.png"
  cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "2_RarefyData", title_plot), Rarefactioncurve_16S, base_height = 35/cm(1), base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)


    
Rarefactioncurve_ITS <- phyloseq.extended::ggrare(ps_ITS_filtered, step = 100, se = FALSE, color = "SampleType", label = "ID_pool") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5000, linetype = "dashed") +  xlim(0, 10000) +  theme_bw()

# Make_rarefaction_curve(phylo_object = ps_ITS_filtered, x_intersection_line = 5000, variable = "SampleType", number_columns = 18 , color_variable = "SampleType", title ="ITS Rarefaction Curves", maxdepth=10000)

title_plot <- "ITS_TM123_Rarefactioncurve.png"
  cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "2_RarefyData", title_plot), Rarefactioncurve_ITS, base_height = 35/cm(1),base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
  
# make a combined plot
RarefactionCurves <- ggpubr::ggarrange(Rarefactioncurve_16S, Rarefactioncurve_ITS,
                    labels = c("A. 16S", "B. ITS"), ncol = 2, nrow = 1, widths = c(1.4, 1.4), legend = "bottom", common.legend = TRUE)

title_plot <- "RarefactionCurves_TM123_AllSamples.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "2_RarefyData", title_plot), RarefactionCurves, base_height = 30/cm(1), base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)  
```

## b. Expe samples
```{r}
# Filter data
ps_16S_filt_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_16S_filtered, Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")

title_plot <- "16S_Expe_TM1&2_Rarefactioncurve.png"

Rarefactioncurve_ITS_expe <- phyloseq.extended::ggrare(ps_ITS_filt_expe, step = 100, se = FALSE, color = "SampleType", label = "ID_pool") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5000, linetype = "dashed") +  xlim(0, 10000) +  ylim(0, 125) + theme_bw()

title_plot <- "ITS_Expe_TM1&2_Rarefactioncurve.png"
  cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "2_RarefyData", title_plot), Rarefactioncurve_ITS_expe, base_height = 35/cm(1),base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
  
# make a combined plot
RarefactionCurves_Expe <- ggpubr::ggarrange(Rarefactioncurve_16S_expe, Rarefactioncurve_ITS_expe,
                    labels = c("A. 16S", "B. ITS"), ncol = 2, nrow = 1, widths = c(1.4, 1.4), legend = "bottom", common.legend = TRUE)

title_plot <- "RarefactionCurves_Expe.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "2_RarefyData", title_plot), RarefactionCurves_Expe, base_height = 30/cm(1), base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)    
```

# 4. Rarefy data

```{r}
# Rarefy samples by discarding samples with fewer than 3.000 reads
set.seed(1)                                         
ps_rare_16S <- rarefy_even_depth(ps_16Sm, sample.size = 3000) # 105 samples + 3167 otus removed
sample_sums(ps_rare_16S)[1:100]

set.seed(1)                                         
ps_rare_ITS <- rarefy_even_depth(ps_ITSm, sample.size = 5000) # 42 samples + 608 otus removed
sample_sums(ps_rare_ITS)[1:100]

## Export
saveRDS(ps_rare_16S, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM123_ps_rare.rds"))
saveRDS(ps_rare_ITS, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM123_ps_rare.rds"))

#16S
otu_df_16S <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_16S))
otu_df_16S$observation_name <- rownames(otu_df_16S)
otu_df_16S <- otu_df_16S %>% dplyr::relocate(observation_name)
write.table(otu_df_16S, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM123_otu_table_ps_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

tax_df_16S <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S))
tax_df_16S$observation_name <- rownames(tax_df_16S)
tax_df_16S <- tax_df_16S %>% dplyr::relocate(observation_name)
write.table(tax_df_16S, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM123_tax_table_ps_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

metadata_16S_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_rare_16S), check.names = FALSE)
write.xlsx(metadata_16S_df, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ps_rare_16S_sample_data.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)

out_rarefied_16S <- anti_join(mtd, metadata_16S_df, by ="ID_pool")
write.xlsx(out_rarefied_16S, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "mtd_samples_outAfterRare_16S.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)

#ITS
otu_df_ITS <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_ITS))
otu_df_ITS$observation_name <- rownames(otu_df_ITS)
otu_df_ITS <- otu_df_ITS %>% dplyr::relocate(observation_name)
write.table(otu_df_ITS, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM123_otu_table_ps_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

tax_df_ITS <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS))
tax_df_ITS$observation_name <- rownames(tax_df_ITS)
tax_df_ITS <- tax_df_ITS %>% dplyr::relocate(observation_name)
write.table(tax_df_ITS,file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM123_tax_table_ps_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

metadata_ITS_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_rare_ITS), check.names = FALSE)
write.xlsx(metadata_ITS_df, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ps_rare_ITS_sample_data.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)

out_rarefied_ITS <- anti_join(mtd, metadata_ITS_df, by ="ID_pool")
write.xlsx(out_rarefied_ITS, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "mtd_samples_outAfterRare_ITS.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)
```
